import os
import subprocess
import tempfile
from flask import Flask, request, jsonify, send_file
import hashlib
import hmac

app = Flask(__name__)

UPLOAD_DIR = os.environ.get('UPLOAD_DIR', '/tmp/uploads')
REPORT_TEMPLATE = os.environ.get('REPORT_TEMPLATE', '/opt/templates/report.tex')

os.makedirs(UPLOAD_DIR, exist_ok=True)

def verify_session(token):
    """Verify session token against internal auth service"""
    secret = os.environ.get('SESSION_SECRET', 'dev-secret')
    parts = token.split('.')
    if len(parts) != 2:
        return None
    payload, sig = parts
    expected = hmac.new(secret.encode(), payload.encode(), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()[:16]
    if hmac.compare_digest(sig, expected):
        return payload
    return None

@app.route('/api/generate-report', methods=['POST'])
def generate_report():
    """Generate PDF report from user-supplied data merged into LaTeX template"""
    auth = request.headers.get('X-Session-Token')
    if not auth:
        return jsonify({'error': 'unauthorized'}), 401
    
    data = request.get_json()
    if not data:
        return jsonify({'error': 'missing body'}), 400
    
    title = data.get('title', 'Untitled Report')
    author = data.get('author', 'Anonymous')
    sections = data.get('sections', [])
    
    # Build LaTeX document body from user input
    doc_body = f"\\title{{{title}}}\n\\author{{{author}}}\n\\maketitle\n"
    
    for section in sections:
        section_title = section.get('heading', '')
        section_content = section.get('body', '')
        doc_body += f"\\section{{{section_title}}}\n{section_content}\n\n"
    
    # Read template and inject content
    try:
        with open(REPORT_TEMPLATE, 'r') as f:
            template = f.read()
    except FileNotFoundError:
        template = "\\documentclass{article}\n\\begin{document}\n%%CONTENT%%\n\\end{document}"
    
    final_doc = template.replace('%%CONTENT%%', doc_body)
    
    # Write to temp file and compile
    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(mode='w', suffix='.tex', dir=UPLOAD_DIR, delete=False) as tf:
        tf.write(final_doc)
        tex_path = tf.name
    
    output_dir = os.path.dirname(tex_path)
    base_name = os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(tex_path))[0]
    
    # Compile LaTeX to PDF
    cmd = [
        'pdflatex',
        '-interaction=nonstopmode',
        f'-output-directory={output_dir}',
        tex_path
    ]
    
    result = subprocess.run(
        cmd,
        capture_output=True,
        timeout=30,
        cwd=output_dir
    )
    
    pdf_path = os.path.join(output_dir, f'{base_name}.pdf')
    
    if os.path.exists(pdf_path):
        return send_file(pdf_path, mimetype='application/pdf')
    else:
        # Return compilation log for debugging
        log_path = os.path.join(output_dir, f'{base_name}.log')
        log_content = ''
        if os.path.exists(log_path):
            with open(log_path, 'r') as lf:
                log_content = lf.read()[-2000:]
        return jsonify({
            'error': 'compilation failed',
            'stderr': result.stderr.decode('utf-8', errors='replace')[-1000:],
            'log_tail': log_content
        }), 500

@app.route('/api/health', methods=['GET'])
def health():
    return jsonify({'status': 'ok', 'version': '2.1.4'})

if __name__ == '__main__':
    app.run(host='0.0.0.0', port=8080)
